story_title: OpenAI and Intuit Partner in $100M+ Deal to Bring Financial Tools to ChatGPT
caption:
OpenAI and Intuit just announced a $100M+ multi-year partnership to bring Intuit app experiences directly inside ChatGPT.

Here is why this matters: ChatGPT is transitioning from a standalone chatbot into a full operating platform. By embedding tools like TurboTax and QuickBooks directly into frontier models, financial management is moving into conversational interfaces.

What app ecosystem do you think moves into ChatGPT next?

alt_text_overall: Carousel breakdown of OpenAI and Intuit's $100M+ partnership bringing financial tools directly into ChatGPT.
alt_text_per_slide: Slide 1: A $100M+ DEAL JUST CHANGED CHATGPT.. OpenAI and Intuit are joining forces to bring personalized financial app experiences directly inside ChatGPT. — shown as a bold statement over a torn-edge color block.

Slide 2: FINANCES INSIDE THE AI CHAT. The multi-year agreement brings Intuit app capabilities into ChatGPT while leveraging OpenAI frontier models for financial intelligence. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 3: $100M+ MULTI-YEAR DEAL. The commitment combines OpenAI's frontier models with Intuit's financial data engine to deliver personalized automated guidance. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 4: CHATGPT IS BECOMING AN OS.. By embedding full financial apps directly into conversational prompts, ChatGPT shifts from a research tool to an execution engine. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 5: THE ERA OF FRONTIER WORKFLOWS. Enterprise AI is no longer about basic API access. It is about deep ecosystem integration where models execute complex tasks. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 6: WHAT THIS MEANS FOR YOU. Expect conversational AI to handle tax preparation, budget tracking, and business bookkeeping without switching between apps. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 7: THE FUTURE IS INTEGRATED.. The winning AI tools won't just generate text—they will operate your financial and operational software directly. — shown as a bold statement over a torn-edge color block.
